content.text: The evidence is clear and consistent. The license card image confirms exactly what OCR read.

input.explanation: The physical license card (f009:p10) clearly shows EXP 02/17/2025 and ISS 01/06/2021, confirmed by both OCR and the image. The MVR report (f009:p9) shows a newer record issued 04/09/2025 with an expiration of 02/17/2030. The two documents genuinely reflect different issuances of the license — the card is the older, expired version while the MVR reflects the current renewed license.
